subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’,

A @ B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A - B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

and A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is O related to V if ‘O + P @ T # G - V’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb86236c70f6b13342563bee3389abd393037a3c0264856a0a87c27f649871f9.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
+

-

**Meaning**

 
 
 
sister

 
 
 
brother

 
 
 
wife

 
 
 
father

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

 

Given: O + P @ T # G - V

It means: O is the sister of P, P is the brother of T, T is the father of G, G is the wife of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e4e848fb17c352d0b20840a3d6c06d3b203964b5b18331a60130fc327dd7436.png] 

Thus, O is V's Wife's father's sister.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
